$comment: How ticfac gets the two contracts that stayed ticks' when the ownership split (tick 4i8). ticfac authors its own bundle: contracts/bundle.json carries ticfac's version, contracts/CHANGELOG.md is ticfac's, and every contract describing a ticfac format is edited and re-cut here. ticks' bundle 7.0.0 came down to exactly two files — the published `tk --json` surface and the tracker's on-disk layout — and this pin is how those two stay vendored. `bundleVersion` is the ticks bundle version the vendored bytes were published at, bound to bytes online by `verify-upstream`; `ref` is the immutable ticks commit they were fetched at. `files` is the ticks-owned half of contracts/; every one of them also rides inside ticfac's own bundle, so the offline check and the readers' map cover it. Regenerate `digests` with `go run ./cmd/contracts sync`; never hand-edit a ticks-owned fixture.
